description: MINT targets - ELW or Water World with pristine HMC moon (no bio/geo/volcanism)
comment: Finds systems with Earth-like worlds or Water worlds that have High Metal Content moons orbiting them. The HMC moons must have no biological signals, no geological signals, and no volcanism - making them ideal pristine mining targets.

bodies.comment: Match ELW or Water World (the parent planet) - mark with $elw_water variable
Match High Metal Content body orbiting the specific ELW/Water World - must be pristine (no volcanism)
